The same hierarchy turns the prior overlap-collapse family density base B_*=2+4*24^(1/3) into J_m(eps)<=B_*^(m-1).

result.scope: Exact refutation of the conditional marginal-cap step in a decoupled sum/difference proof, exact repaired Renyi-spread inequality, and an admissible separated-interval family forcing the repaired loss to grow like N^2.
